device.category: 5-voice analogue polyphonic synthesizer, 44-key Fatar keyboard (also desktop module), with digital effects
device.based_on: Draws on the Oberheim OB-X, Four Voice and TVS: SEM-lineage state-variable filter, OB-8 envelope curves; released 2024 (Oberheim, with Sequential).

sources.title: Oberheim TEO-5 User Guide

architecture.polyphony_mode: 5-voice polyphonic; unison 1-5 voices with key priority, or chord memory (up to 5 notes)
architecture.patch_memory_note: 512 programs: 256 user and 256 factory (factory button toggles); sequences, chord memory, effects and per-program scale saved with the program; add-on banks via bank select 9-12.
architecture.summary: Per voice: Osc 1 and Osc 2 (triangle, saw, pulse, any combination; 5-octave + minor-third range; Osc 2 detune), a sub from Osc 1, white/pink noise, through-zero X-Mod (Osc 2 triangle to Osc 1) and hard sync (Osc 2 resets Osc 1); a mixer of on/level per source; a 12 dB/oct SEM-lineage state-variable filter whose STATE morphs low-pass, notch (or band-pass) and high-pass, non-self-oscillating; Osc 2 can bypass the filter. Two DADSR envelopes (OB-8 curves) on fixed routings. LFO 1 global, LFO 2 per voice, five shapes each with a direct destination. 16-slot mod matrix. Analogue overdrive and vintage knob; one digital effect (12 types) plus plate reverb. Arpeggiator, 64-step polyphonic sequencer, low split (keyboard).

modules.name: Keyboard and voice assigner
modules.description: 44-key Fatar (velocity, channel aftertouch) or MIDI; 5 voices, unison 1-5 with key mode, chord memory, hold, portamento (per oscillator), transpose, low split.

modules.name: Oscillator 1
modules.description: Analogue VCO: triangle, saw and pulse together; key tracking switchable; receives through-zero X-Mod and sync from Osc 2.

modules.name: Oscillator 2
modules.description: Analogue VCO: triangle, saw and pulse together; detune ±49.2 cents; its triangle drives X-Mod; can bypass the filter.

modules.name: Mixer
modules.description: Osc 1, Sub, Osc 2 and Noise buttons, each with a level (hold the button and turn VALUE).

modules.name: State-variable filter
modules.description: Discrete SEM-lineage 12 dB/oct (2-pole) state-variable filter; STATE morphs low-pass, notch (band-pass when enabled) and high-pass; resonance; does not self-oscillate.

modules.name: VCA
modules.description: Voice amplifier with pan; Osc 2 can join here when it bypasses the filter.

modules.name: Envelope 1
modules.description: DADSR (OB-8 curves): filter envelope, or auxiliary (via the matrix) depending on ENV ROUTING; bipolar amount, velocity, repeat.

modules.name: Envelope 2
modules.description: DADSR: amp; filter + amp; or filter + gated amp, per ENV ROUTING; bipolar amount, velocity, repeat.

modules.name: LFO 1 (global)
modules.description: Monophonic LFO, 0.022-500 Hz or synced: triangle, saw, reverse saw, square, S&H; amount to one direct destination; slew, note reset.

modules.name: LFO 2 (poly)
modules.description: Per-voice LFO with the same controls as LFO 1.

modules.name: Overdrive
modules.description: Analogue overdrive on the voice sum, separate from the digital effects.

modules.name: Effect
modules.description: One digital effect: stereo delay, BBD, tape delay 1/2, chorus, flanger, phaser, HP filter, distortion, ring mod (Maestro/Oberheim), rotating speaker, lo-fi; tempo sync for delays.

modules.name: Reverb
modules.description: Plate reverb: mix, decay, pre-delay, tone (HP and LP), size.

modules.name: Arpeggiator and sequencer
modules.description: Arpeggiator (up, down, up+down, random, assign; 1-3 octaves; repeats; relatch) and 64-step polyphonic step sequencer (up to 5-note chords, rests, ties); 30-250 BPM.

modules.name: Output
modules.description: Stereo outputs (or mono via global), headphones; master and program volume.

connections.note: Gated amp; Env 2 velocity then affects only the filter.
Five voices summed, panned in stereo.

mod_matrix.name: Modulation matrix
mod_matrix.note: 16 slots (19 sources plus Off, 64 destinations plus none); the display marks each as mono (M) or poly (P); a mono source on a poly destination acts monophonically. Shortcut: hold SOURCE and move a control or press keys, hold DESTINATION and move a control. LFO 1/2 and Env 1 also have direct destinations (0-61) outside the slots.

indicators.label: OLED display
indicators.function: Program, mod slots (with M/P flags), menus, effect name, clock division, sequencer step.

behaviours.name: Signal path
behaviours.rule: Per voice: Osc 1, sub, Osc 2 and noise into the 12 dB state-variable filter (Osc 2 can bypass it), then the VCA and pan. Voices summed into overdrive, one digital effect and the plate reverb, then stereo out (or mono).

behaviours.name: Envelope routing
behaviours.rule: ENV ROUTING cycles: Env 1 to filter and Env 2 to amp (default); Env 1 aux and Env 2 to filter and amp; Env 1 aux and Env 2 to filter with the amp gated (velocity then affects only the filter). Env Repeat loops delay-attack-decay.

behaviours.name: Oscillator interaction
behaviours.rule: X-Mod: through-zero FM from Osc 2's triangle to Osc 1 (analogue, may drift). SYNC 2-1: Osc 2 resets Osc 1. The PULSE WIDTH knob moves both widths keeping their offset; hold a pulse button to set one.

behaviours.name: Global and poly LFOs
behaviours.rule: LFO 1 is one modulator for all voices; LFO 2 runs per voice, so chords played at different times modulate out of phase. Each has its own direct destination and amount; the matrix can add more.

behaviours.name: Mod matrix
behaviours.rule: 16 slots of source, bipolar amount and destination; mono and poly sources and destinations as flagged in the display.

behaviours.name: Unison and chord memory
behaviours.rule: Unison stacks 1-5 voices with detune 0-7 and low/high/last priority. Hold a chord (up to five notes) and press UNISON to memorise it; clear by pressing UNISON with a single note held after turning unison off.

behaviours.name: Sequencer
behaviours.rule: 64 steps of notes or chords (up to five notes) with velocity; PROGRAM enters a rest, WRITE a tie; no timing is recorded. PLAY starts; hold RECORD and press a key to transpose from middle C. Saved with the program.

behaviours.name: Programs
behaviours.rule: 512 programs (256 user, 256 factory). BANK + 1-8 then 1-16 selects; WRITE twice saves (factory edits go to user). MANUAL plays the panel. Basic Program: TRANSPOSE -2 + LOW SPLIT -2.

source_inconsistencies: Many guide pages carry a 'Take 5 User's Guide' footer, and the MIDI document says CCs are 'mapped to Pro 3 controls' (copied from other Sequential documents).
CC 5 is listed as 'Glide Mode (Portamento Time)' with range 0-3; it matches Glide Mode (NRPN 30).
The guide's Transpose section says transpose settings are global and not saved, then that transpose can be saved per patch; the NRPN table includes Transpose as a program parameter.
Pitch bend: the guide gives 12 semitones up and 24 down; Arp Repeat is '1, 2, 3' then described from 'off'.
The guide states 512 programs selected as bank 1-8 plus program 1-16 (e.g. 'program 512' as bank 5, program 12), which does not multiply out to 256 per set.
MIDI Sysex On is described in the MIDI document with the MIDI Control text.
Weight is 7.7 kg (17 lb) on Oberheim's and Thomann's pages and 21 lb on another retailer's; the desktop is 6.8 lb (Oberheim) or 10 lb / 4.5 kg (Perfect Circuit).

modelling_gaps.detail: Voice modules modelled once (per_voice); LFO 1, overdrive, effects and sequencer are common.
LFO 1, LFO 2 and Env 1 (aux) each have a direct destination selected in the display; modelled as parameters, not drawn as connections.
Shares the engine; its LFO section uses a select button for LFO 1/2. Not modelled separately.
